population.assignment: each valid voxel is assigned to exactly one active BrainRegions mapping member

hemispheres.stored: physical lateralized rows; negative atlas ID is left and positive atlas ID is right
hemispheres.both_definition: exact elementwise sum of left and right rows
hemispheres.processed_agea_split_interpretation: not biological because upstream processing bilaterally averaged the values

binning.edges: reuse the exact release-owned global volume binning edges
binning.probability_denominator: the selected mapped region and hemisphere population

agea.label_semantics: BrainRegions indices paired with the official 200 um AGEA BrainAtlas

registration_audit_against_pinned_allen_.interpretation: source-native labels remain authoritative; disagreement is expected at coarse 200 um boundaries
